monthly_trend: Lines show {history_count} closed months. Revenue and profit are in RUB excluding VAT; missing periods are not replaced by zeros.
product_contribution: Bars show each product contribution to the net revenue change versus {previous_period}, in RUB. These are absolute differences, not growth rates.
region_contribution: Bars show regional contributions to period net revenue change in RUB. These are not plan deviations.
channel_economics: Bars compare {current_period} channel net revenue in RUB. Review profit and weighted margin as well to assess economics.
region_plan_gap: Bars show {current_period} actual minus plan by region in RUB. A negative bar indicates underperformance.
channel_profitability: The table compares channel net revenue, profit and margin. Money columns are RUB; margin is a percentage calculated as a ratio of totals.
plan_actual: Paired bars compare {current_period} actual and plan revenue and profit in RUB. Each month-region-product plan key is counted once.
product_structure: Product shares use total {current_period} net revenue as denominator across all products. A nonpositive base cannot support a percentage conclusion.
refunds: The table shows refunds and gross revenue in RUB. Refund share is their percentage ratio; discounts are not deducted from the denominator.
priorities: The table shows product net revenue and profit totals in RUB. This is financial detail; actions and spending limits are in the separate decision table.
quarter_kpi: KPIs show {current_period} net revenue and profit in RUB. The semantic margin metric is a ratio of totals, not an average of percentages.
